concept.title: Mast Abbreviations
concept.shortdesc: Below are abbreviations that may appear on the Identification, Lift Capacity and Attachment Plate and

conbody.p: Below are abbreviations that may appear on the Identification, Lift Capacity and Attachment Plate and their meanings
STD - Standard Mast (single inner member, low free lift)
FF - Full Free Lift Mast (single inner member with high free lift duplex cylinder)
FFT - Triple Lift Mast (two inner members) with either low or full free lift characteristics.
QUAD - Quadruple (Quad) Mast(with three inner members)
conbody.note: When only a mast-type is listed on the identification plate, a standard carriage and forks are used.
